name: code
description: Understand a codebase, then verify it. core primes a repo once — a deterministic zero-token knowledge graph via graphify plus a CORE tree of CLAUDE.md contracts with AGENTS.md symlinks — so later questions cost a graph query instead of a file sweep. e2e-harness discovers a polyglot system from its own docs and generates runnable end-to-end suites across Node, Python, Go, C#, Rust, Kafka and Playwright. CORE is adapted from DOX (agent0ai/dox, MIT).
